source_snapshot.procedure: Invoke userspace errortype1 without a victim/page binding under Data Poisoning Auto.
source_snapshot.criteria: UCE report and a fatal condition that only `may` occur, without a deterministic outcome.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; generic UCE logs cannot prove victim, poison delivery or fatal disposition.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires victim binding, poison-consume action, outcome matrix and recovery.

old_problem: Neither the targeted userspace page nor Data Poisoning Auto/consume semantics are defined, and `may result in fatal conditions` provides no PASS/FAIL oracle for process containment, machine check, reset or boot recovery.
disposition_reason: This row lacks both core target semantics and an authoritative expected result. A UCE may be recorded at injection but delivered only on line consumption, so victim binding and consume action determine the actual test. ED-15 rejects an optional `may` result and ED-16 requires deterministic containment/recovery. No standard can supply the AMD tool's victim/poison behavior, so Pending/BLOCKED must remain.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row 48, AI fields, historical record 2450 and next pending row 49.
Preserved userspace UCE, all-slot and possible-fatal coverage independently of CE/address/implicit modes.
Separated injection from any approved poisoned-line consumption action.
Required offline OOB evidence because fatal handling may prevent host-log flush.
No victim access, injection, poison consumption, reset or recovery occurred.

test_case.test_name: AMD userspace UCE poison-delivery and containment per slot
test_case.purpose: Target a known synthetic userspace page on each required slot, inject one UCE, apply only the approved consume action and verify the deterministic process/platform containment and recovery policy.
required_package: Disposable pinned victim and page-to-slot map
Data Poisoning Auto and consume-action semantics
Allowed process/MCA/reset/fatal/boot outcome matrix with deadlines
OOB evidence, poison cleanup and full recovery/restoration
test_case.test_command: Do not inject or consume a line. Once the contract exists, bind one synthetic page/slot, run one authorized UCE under continuous OOB capture, perform the exact approved access if required, compare process/OS/platform behavior with the outcome matrix, clean poison/allocation, recover and restore before separately authorizing another slot.
test_case.expected_result: The known victim/slot follows exactly one approved containment path within deadline, records the attributable UCE, and returns the platform and memory to a clean healthy baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS exists while the expected result is `may`. Tool PASS, generic fatality, unexplained survival/reset, unknown victim, missing consume evidence or residual poison cannot pass.
safety_gate: Disposable synthetic data on a backed-up isolated SUT with OOB power/reimage access.
No action until victim, poison-delivery and accepted outcome are signed.
One page/slot only; abort on wrong victim, result outside matrix, lost console, boot loop or persistent poison.
Never auto-retry, reset or advance coverage.
expected_evidence: Outcome-matrix match, poison cleanup, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: The owner must define process termination, reset/power/reimage, persistent-poison removal and boot-health gates for each allowed outcome; absence of this deterministic recovery keeps execution blocked.
